name: setout
description: SetOut: design, measure, quote and make frameless showers. One engine, shared by the embedded designer, the trade workspace and the API.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @setout/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @setout/workspace && npm run build -w @setout/designer
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && npm run deploy:staging -w @setout/api
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npm run deploy:production -w @setout/api
